 First Alert Forecast: Gloomy skies, spooky showers Halloween weekend 
 Shower chances increase late Saturday and early Sunday 
 By Darius Mack Published : Oct. 30, 2026 at 6:41 PM CDT | Updated : Oct. 31, 2026 at 6:10 PM CDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google NASHVILLE, Tenn. (WSMV) - The forecast calls for festive skies and occasional showers this weekend. Rain is expected to return to the Midstate as October comes to a close. Will the rain hold off for trick-or-treaters? Right now, Saturday is looking mostly dry. 
 THE NEXT 24 HOURS 
 Saturday’s skies are mostly cloudy with an isolated sprinkle possible Saturday evening. Rain chances pick up late Saturday, after 10 p.m. 
 For life-saving weather alerts, customized messages on conditions and forecasts, and videos detailing upcoming weather events, download the WSMV 4 First Alert Weather app for iPhone or Android . Have weather pictures or videos? Share them here. 
 SATURDAY’S FORECAST 
 Evening: Cloudy, a few isolated showers early evening. Rain chances increase late Saturday.
 SUNDAY’S FORECAST 
 Morning: Periods of rain, temperatures in the 50s.
 Afternoon: Additional scattered showers, cool and dreary. High temperature, 65. 
 Evening: Spotty showers around, rain chances eventually ease away as temperatures drop into the 50s.
 MONDAY’S FORECAST 
 Morning: Mostly cloudy with spotty showers around. Temperatures in the 50s.
 Afternoon: Clouds break away. High temperatures in the 70s.
 Evening: Cooler and breezy.
